topic: Splitting the Check at a Diner

script.title: SPLITTING THE CHECK
script.story_hook: Two friends, one check, and a dessert-shaped problem.
script.intro_zh: 兩個朋友、一張單，還有一份甜點引起的小麻煩。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone! Today we're splitting a diner check.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好！今天來練習在餐館怎麼分賬。
script.outro: No more awkward bill moments. Practice those lines!
script.outro_zh: 結賬不再尷尬，趕快把這些句子練起來！
script.practice_intro_en: Now your turn. Repeat each line aloud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你了，大聲跟著每一句唸。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💵分賬英文｜分開結賬・現金刷卡・小費比例｜聽完就會結賬｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
朋友團吃完飯，誰付多少該怎麼開口？
不對等分賬、現金找零、小費比例，英文全不會怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進一家復古美式餐館，跟著兩位朋友與服務生從要單、分單、改小費到找零道別，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧾 要單與分賬：例如「could we get the check, please?」、「not exactly fifty-fifty.」
💳 現金與刷卡：例如「Cash or card for her?」、「I'll grab change at the register.」
💰 小費與收尾：例如「You can change it.」、「Let's do twenty percent.」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次結賬，你會是桌上最從容的那一個！
script.thumbnail_expression: half smiling, holding up two dollar bills
script.thumbnail_action: handing the check folder across the booth table

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse us, could we get the check, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz ʌs kʊd wi ɡɛt ðə tʃɛk pliz/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，可以讓我們結賬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming right up. Splitting it today?
dialogue.zh: 馬上來。今天要分開結嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but um, not exactly fifty-fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ʌm nɑt ɪɡˈzæktli ˈfɪfti ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 要的，但呃……不用剛好對半分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally fine. How do you want to split?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtli faɪn haʊ du ju wɑnt tə splɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend ordered dessert; I skipped mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd ˈɔrdərd dɪˈzərt aɪ skɪpt maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友點了甜點，我沒點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy. I'll move the dessert to her side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi aɪl muv ðə dɪˈzərt tə hɜr saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 簡單，我把甜點挪到她那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. What's the damage on my side?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpərfɪkt wʌts ðə ˈdæmɪdʒ ɑn maɪ saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我這邊總共多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours is thirty-one forty, with tax.
dialogue.zh: 您這邊是三十一塊四，含稅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her side has dessert, so about eighteen?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr saɪd hæz dɪˈzərt soʊ əˈbaʊt ˈeɪˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 她那邊含甜點，大概十八塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineteen twenty. Cash or card for her?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnˈtin ˈtwɛnti kæʃ ɔr kɑrd fɔr hɜr/
dialogue.zh: 十九塊二。她要用現金還是卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's digging in her bag... yes, cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz ˈdɪɡɪŋ ɪn hɜr bæɡ jɛz kæʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool. I'll grab change at the register quick.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul aɪl ɡræb tʃeɪndʒ æt ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər kwɪk/
dialogue.zh: 好，我快去收銀台給她找零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For me, card, please. Now about the tip...
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr mi kɑrd pliz naʊ əˈbaʊt ðə tɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我用刷卡。對了，小費怎麼弄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's added before you tap. You can change it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈædəd bɪˈfɔr ju tæp ju kæn tʃeɪndʒ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 感應前會先加上，比例可以自己改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Let's do twenty percent, great service.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd lɛts du ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt ɡreɪt ˈsɜrvəs/
dialogue.zh: 好，就百分之二十，服務很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that's really kind of you two.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðæts ˈrɪli kaɪnd ʌv ju tu/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你們，兩位真是太體貼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our pleasure. Where's the restroom, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊər ˈplɛʒər wɛrz ðə ˈrumˌrʌm baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。順問一下，洗手間在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back left past the counter. Have a good night!
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk lɛft pæst ðə ˈkaʊntər hæv ə ɡʊd naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 經過櫃台左邊那間。祝你們晚安！
